encodings.note: Fast call to privilege level 0 system procedures.

exceptions.when: The SYSCALL instruction is not recognized in protected mode.
The SYSCALL instruction is not recognized in real-address mode.
The SYSCALL instruction is not recognized in virtual-8086 mode.
The SYSCALL instruction is not recognized in compatibility mode.
If IA32_EFER.SCE = 0. If the LOCK prefix is used.

If FRED event delivery of SYSCALL would load RIP with a non-canonical address. If FRED event delivery of SYSCALL would load SSP with an address that is not 8-byte aligned. If a shadow-stack access performed by FRED event delivery of SYSCALL uses a non-canonical address or causes a LASS violation.
If an ordinary stack access performed by FRED event delivery of SYSCALL uses a non-canonical address or causes a LASS violation.
If a memory access performed by FRED event delivery of SYSCALL causes a page fault.
